summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.total: sums the tenant's approved entries (refunds included) and rounds the sum to 2 dp with MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero (DF-FXL-0007). Banker's rounding (superseded RQ-FXL-0103) is not used. All acceptance criteria verified by passing tests.

criteria.test: total rounds approved 0.005 away from zero to 0.01
total rounds approved -0.005 away from zero to -0.01

criteria.criterion: Unapproved entries and other tenants' entries do not count
criteria.test: total excludes unapproved entries and other tenants' entries

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.approve with the checks of RQ-FXL-0004 in order: isActive (SessionExpired), Approver role (NotAuthorized, flat roles), entry lookup in the session tenant (NotFound), the RQ-FXL-0104 amendment (amount > 10000 requires both Approver and Admin, NotAuthorized, placed after the lookup and before self-approval), self-approval (SelfApproval), already approved (AlreadyApproved). On success sets Approved and ApprovedBy only. Note: the amendment check uses the literal Amount > 10000, so a large negative refund amount is not treated as high-value; the package does not say otherwise. All acceptance criteria verified by passing tests.

criteria.criterion: A session idle for exactly 15 minutes can approve
criteria.test: approve accepts a session idle for exactly 15 minutes

criteria.criterion: At 15 minutes 1 second the session gets SessionExpired
criteria.test: approve rejects a session idle for 15 minutes 1 second with SessionExpired

criteria.criterion: An Admin without Approver gets NotAuthorized
criteria.test: approve rejects an Admin without Approver with NotAuthorized

criteria.criterion: (RQ-FXL-0104) An Approver without Admin approving an entry of 10,000.01 gets NotAuthorized
criteria.test: approve rejects an Approver without Admin for an amount of 10000.01 with NotAuthorized

criteria.criterion: (RQ-FXL-0104) An entry of exactly 10,000 needs only Approver
criteria.test: approve accepts an amount of exactly 10000 with Approver only

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.view: returns SessionExpired when the session is not active (FxIdentity.Identity.isActive), otherwise the entries whose TenantId equals the session's tenant, in original order. No role widens the result (DF-FXL-0005 supersedes DF-FXL-0002; the fx-ledger README note that Administrators can view all tenants is stale and was not implemented). All acceptance criteria verified by passing tests.

criteria.criterion: An Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries
criteria.test: view shows an Admin of t1 only t1 entries
view returns SessionExpired for an expired session

summary: Not implemented. The package status is INCOMPLETE: RQ-FXL-0008 (convert amounts between currencies) is proposed and has no acceptance criteria; its dependency DF-FXL-0009 (choice of exchange-rate source) is draft and undecided. Rounding and the rate date are not specified, so convertCurrency would require invented rates, rules or sources. FxLedger.Ledger.convertCurrency still raises 'not implemented'. No tests were written because there are no acceptance criteria to verify.
